examples.ru: Предложение, однако, оставалось спорным.

common_mistake.wrong: The evidence was limited, however the panel decided.
common_mistake.right: The evidence was limited; however, the panel decided.
common_mistake.note: Две независимые части нельзя соединять одной запятой перед however.

quizzes.prompt: Choose the correctly punctuated sentence.
options: Demand fell; however, profits remained stable.
Demand fell, however profits remained stable.
Demand fell however; profits remained stable.
quizzes.explanation: Semicolon separates independent clauses; comma follows however.

quizzes.prompt: Which conjunct expresses result?
quizzes.explanation: Consequently introduces a consequence.

quizzes.prompt: Choose the parenthetical use.
quizzes.explanation: Mid-sentence conjunct is set off by commas.

rule: После предлога используется noun phrase или -ing, даже если to является предлогом. Многие adjective/verb/noun combinations требуют фиксированного предлога, который нужно учить вместе со словом.

examples.en: We look forward to hearing from you.
examples.ru: С нетерпением ждём вашего ответа.

examples.en: She objected to being excluded.
examples.ru: Она возражала против исключения.

examples.en: The system is capable of processing large datasets.
examples.ru: Система способна обрабатывать большие наборы данных.

common_mistake.wrong: I look forward to hear from you.
common_mistake.right: I look forward to hearing from you.
common_mistake.note: Здесь to — предлог, поэтому нужен gerund.

quizzes.prompt: They insisted ___ reviewing the figures again.
quizzes.explanation: Insist takes on + -ing.

quizzes.prompt: He is committed to ___ the service.
quizzes.explanation: Committed to contains prepositional to.

quizzes.prompt: There is little justification ___ delaying the vote.
quizzes.explanation: Justification commonly takes for + -ing.

title_en: Gerund or infinitive with a change of meaning
title_ru: Герундий или инфинитив с изменением значения
rule: После remember, forget, regret, try, stop, mean и go on выбор -ing/to-infinitive меняет временную и смысловую связь: воспоминание о прошлом, обязанность сделать, эксперимент или цель.

examples.en: I remember meeting her at the conference.
examples.ru: Я помню, как встретил её на конференции.

examples.en: Remember to attach the file.
examples.ru: Не забудь прикрепить файл.

examples.en: Try restarting the device.
examples.ru: Попробуйте перезапустить устройство.

common_mistake.wrong: I stopped to smoke means I quit smoking.
common_mistake.right: I stopped smoking means I quit smoking.
common_mistake.note: Stop doing прекращает действие; stop to do означает остановиться ради другого действия.

quizzes.prompt: I regret ___ you that your application was unsuccessful.
quizzes.explanation: Regret to inform is a formal announcement of bad news.

quizzes.prompt: Try ___ the cache; it may solve the problem.
options: to clear with meaning only failed effort
quizzes.explanation: Try doing suggests an experiment.

quizzes.prompt: He stopped ___ a phone call, then continued driving.
quizzes.explanation: He interrupted driving in order to make a call.

title_en: Perfect and passive infinitives and gerunds
title_ru: Совершенные и пассивные инфинитивы и герундии
rule: Perfect forms show that a non-finite action happened earlier than the main verb; passive forms show that the subject receives the action. They can combine: to have been done, having been done.

examples.en: She claims to have completed the work.
examples.ru: Она утверждает, что завершила работу.

examples.en: He resented being ignored.
examples.ru: Его возмущало, что его игнорировали.

examples.en: They denied having been warned.
examples.ru: Они отрицали, что их предупреждали.

common_mistake.wrong: She appears to completed the task.
common_mistake.right: She appears to have completed the task.
common_mistake.note: Для более раннего действия нужен perfect infinitive.

quizzes.prompt: The manuscript is believed ___ in the 17th century.
quizzes.explanation: Earlier passive action: perfect passive infinitive.

quizzes.prompt: He apologised for ___ the deadline.
quizzes.explanation: After for, use gerund; perfect marks earlier action.

quizzes.prompt: She expects ___ about any changes.
quizzes.explanation: She receives the information, so passive infinitive.

title_en: Bare infinitives after perception and causative verbs
title_ru: Bare infinitive после глаголов восприятия и каузативных глаголов
rule: Make, let and sometimes help take bare infinitive in active structures. Perception verbs use bare infinitive for a complete event and -ing for an event in progress. In the passive, make takes to-infinitive.

examples.en: They made us revise the report.
examples.ru: Нас заставили пересмотреть отчёт.

examples.en: We saw the car leave the car park.
examples.ru: Мы видели, как машина выехала с парковки.

examples.en: We saw the car leaving the car park.
examples.ru: Мы видели машину в процессе выезда.

common_mistake.wrong: We were made revise the report.
common_mistake.right: We were made to revise the report.
common_mistake.note: В пассиве после made возвращается to.

quizzes.prompt: The manager let us ___ early.
quizzes.explanation: Let + object + bare infinitive.

quizzes.prompt: I heard someone ___ on the door for several minutes.
options: knock as a completed single event necessarily
quizzes.explanation: -ing presents an ongoing activity.

quizzes.prompt: They were made ___ the entire form again.
quizzes.explanation: Passive of make uses to-infinitive.

rule: Согласование определяется head noun и значением, а не ближайшим словом. Each/every usually singular; a number of + plural verb, the number of + singular; collective nouns vary by dialect and perspective.
forms: collective noun: singular or plural by meaning

examples.en: Each of the proposals has merit.
examples.ru: У каждого предложения есть достоинства.

examples.en: A number of participants have withdrawn.
examples.ru: Несколько участников отказались.

examples.en: The number of complaints has fallen.
examples.ru: Количество жалоб снизилось.

common_mistake.wrong: The list of changes are attached.
common_mistake.right: The list of changes is attached.
common_mistake.note: Head noun list is singular; of changes does not control agreement.

quizzes.prompt: A number of errors ___ been identified.
quizzes.explanation: A number of means several and takes a plural verb.

quizzes.prompt: The number of errors ___ increasing.
quizzes.explanation: The head noun number is singular.

quizzes.prompt: Each of the candidates ___ interviewed separately.
quizzes.explanation: Each is grammatically singular.

title_ru: Конечный вес, конечный фокус и организация информации
rule: Английский предпочитает помещать длинную или новую информацию ближе к концу. Extraposition with it, passive choice and clause ordering help maintain given-before-new information and avoid top-heavy subjects.

examples.en: It is difficult to predict how the market will respond.
examples.ru: Трудно предсказать, как отреагирует рынок.

examples.en: The revised guidelines were published yesterday by the national regulator.
examples.ru: Пересмотренные рекомендации вчера опубликовал национальный регулятор.

examples.en: What matters most is whether the system can adapt.
examples.ru: Главное — сможет ли система адаптироваться.

common_mistake.wrong: To predict how the market will respond to a sudden policy change affecting several sectors is difficult.
common_mistake.right: It is difficult to predict how the market will respond to a sudden policy change affecting several sectors.
common_mistake.note: Extraposition moves a heavy infinitive clause to the end.

quizzes.prompt: Choose the sentence with natural end-weight.
options: It was surprising that so few applicants completed the final stage.
That so few applicants completed the final stage was surprising in ordinary speech.
Was surprising that few applicants the final stage completed.
quizzes.explanation: Extraposition avoids a heavy subject at the beginning.

quizzes.prompt: Why might a writer choose the passive?
options: To keep the current topic in subject position
Because passive is always more formal and therefore always better
To remove all information about time
quizzes.explanation: Passive can support topic continuity and information flow.

quizzes.prompt: English information structure often places ___ information later.
quizzes.explanation: End-focus and end-weight favour new/heavy material at the end.
